checked_scope: The propensity-free cell-mixture approximation, empirical quantile risk lemma, and density-free impossibility example.
checks: Cell-arm mixtures preserve uniform CDF Holder error b_h without propensity smoothness; first/second moment errors<=b_h follow survival identities with weights1,2y integrating to1. Variance contrast error uses |mhat^2-m^2|<=2|mhat-m|.

Quantile density c_star on fixed radius and mixture CDF error b_h give Bernoulli tails at the fixed Q+/-t thresholds with drift c_star t-b_h. Integrating the trivial initial segment, Gaussian tails and fixed-radius remainder gives O(b_h^2+1/N), including empirical atoms.

Binomial reciprocal/count-zero bounds yield O(h^(2beta)+h^-d/n). Without density regularity, treatment zero masses1/2 +/- n^-2 give median contrasts-1/2,+1/2 while sample TV<=2/n; nearest-target testing yields risk>=(1-2/n)/8 and honest diameter obstruction. These are marginal contrasts, not individual treatment-effect distributions.
